title: Airborne mapping of Maui's underground fresh water
summary: On April 22, the final motion to spend $1.8 million in water supply carryover savings on airborne electromagnetic data collection in West Maui was read into the record. The budget director said the water director will move forward with the project, though the administration would prefer the state take the lead. The member who proposed it said the data would show where to drill wells, and a second year would map the Haleakalā aquifer.
